title_human: L(2,chi_-3)/CDT source identification, L(3,chi_5) six-sheet S3/S4 attack, and Catalan level-16 K-module obstruction

claims.statement: The general classification selects the hidden fully inner-purified Zagier source Phi_pur = (1-2V_2)(1-8V_2) E_{3,chi_-3,1} = 3*Phi_C - 2*Phi_F, with L(Phi_pur,2) = (1/4) L(2,chi_-3). It also has the exact level-12 realization Phi_pur = psi^3 (1+u)^2 (3-4u-3u^2) D(u/3), derived from the project's previously established level-12 identities.
claims.object: L(2, chi_-3) level-12 purified Eisenstein source
claims.notes: Presented as a completed, compiled standalone research-note result (11-page PDF), not merely numerical.

claims.statement: The note proves the exact source-level identification with CDT: D^2 B_CDT = (1-8V_2) E_{3,chi_-3,1} = Phi_C, and D^2 C_CDT = (1-V_2) E_{3,1,chi_-3} = Phi_A. CDT use these sources with a common weight-one period on Y_0(6), obtaining two corrected functions carrying L(2,chi_-3)/2 and zeta(2)/4, both overconverging through the x=1/9 singularity; CDT's theorem is the Q-linear independence of 1, zeta(2), L(2,chi_-3).
claims.object: CDT (Calegari-Dimitrov-Tang) L(2,chi_-3) construction vs. project's Eisenstein sources
claims.notes: CDT's linear-independence theorem is external published literature; the project's contribution is identifying CDT's sources exactly with its own Phi_A, Phi_C objects. Certificate said to end with 'ALL EXACT ASSERTIONS PASSED.'

claims.statement: For the L(3,chi_5) six-sheet construction: pushing the purified inner source S_pur = (1-4V_2)(1-16V_2) E_{4,chi_5,1} from level 20 down to the level-5 elliptic host gives a degree-6 cover with [Gamma_0(5):Gamma_0(20)]=6, and the full level-5 monodromy on the six sheets has order 24, acting as the standard S_4 action on the six edges of a tetrahedron, giving Q_6 = 1 (+) V_3 (+) V_2.
claims.notes: Described as an exact finite-representation construction with a symbolic certificate, but explicitly not yet promoted to a full arithmetic-holonomy theorem by the thread itself.

claims.statement: The six-sheet period vector is exactly v = (Lambda/4)(0,1,1,1,1,1) + (5/25) i pi^3 (0,1,-1,-3,3,0) where Lambda = L(3,chi_5); writing T=(0,1,-1,-3,3,0), the S_3 trace gives Tr_{S_3}(v) = (5/4) L(3,chi_5) and the sign-trace gives Tr_{S_3}^{sign}(v) = -(1/4) L(3,chi_5), with no pi^3 term in either, i.e. the entire pi^3 defect lies in the standard S_3-isotypic part and is absent from the trivial and sign components.
claims.object: L(3,chi_5) six-sheet period vector / Tate-regulator separation
claims.notes: Called the 'conceptual breakthrough' of that sub-thread, verified by a symbolic certificate script (l3chi5_six_sheet_s4_certificate.py), but assistant explicitly cautions this is only a Layer-B/representation-theoretic separation, not yet a proof of overconvergence or an irrationality result.

claims.statement: The apparent Hadamard-construction 'conformal gain of 2' for the earlier L(3,chi_5) approach was an artifact of the substitution x=125z; in the natural arithmetic variable z the true gain is 2/125, meaning the earlier scalar Hadamard argument was misleading unless the 5-adic place is included.
claims.notes: One of two explicit negative findings reported; the Hadamard route to L(3,chi_5) is treated as superseded by the six-sheet S_3/S_4 approach.

claims.statement: L(3,chi_5) ranking after this sub-thread: relative to G=beta(2) and zeta(5), the assistant assessed L(3,chi_5)'s irrationality prospects as 'speculative' (vs. 'more credible' for G and 'very difficult' for zeta(5)), while all three were rated 'high' structural payoff; the user then decided to abandon the L(3,chi_5) line ('yeah do G. we can leave L3,chi5').
claims.notes: Explicit user decision to deprioritize this line at this point in the thread; the six-sheet result stands as unfinished/open rather than disproved.

claims.statement: For the Catalan level-16 conditional object K(y) = [B(x)-D(x)-G*A(x)]/(1-x), y=(x-1)/x^2, x=8t: with A_n = C(2n,n)^2 and A_n/R_n = (1/2) * sum_{j=0}^{n-1} (2j+1)^2 C(2j,j) / 4^j exactly, and consequently G = (1/2) * sum_{j>=0} (2j+1)^2 C(2j,j) / 4^j.
claims.object: Catalan's constant level-16 K-module, exact Wronskian formula
claims.notes: Presented as a fully derived exact discrete-Wronskian identity, not conditional on G in Q.

claims.statement: For the same K-module, d_n^2 R_n is an integer for every n, and this exponent is sharp: for every odd prime p, v_p(R_p) = -2, giving log Q_n = 2n + o(n) for the common denominator Q_n of R_0,...,R_n — i.e. the arithmetic cost 2 is real with no hidden Cooper-style free integration.
claims.notes: Explicitly contrasted with the Cooper-cubic 'free integration' phenomenon from the trunk (see trunk): here that phenomenon does not occur.

claims.statement: In the variable z=(1-s^2)/16, K(s) has the exact expansion K(s) = -(pi^2/8) sum_{m>=0} C(2m,m)^2/16^m * s^{2m} + (1/2) sum_{m>=0} [(2m+1) C(2m,m)/4^m]^2 s^{2m+1}. At the first fold s=0 (z=1/16), K(1/16) = -pi^2/8, and at the principal Taylor cusp s=+1 the two logarithmic contributions cancel exactly, so K crosses the nearest fold with only a square-root mode (no logarithm) — giving the asymptotic G - A_n/R_n ~ sqrt(pi)/(4 sqrt(n)) and hence K_n ~ -(pi/4) n^{3/2} 16^n.
claims.object: Catalan level-16 K-module, first-fold analytic continuation
claims.notes: Framed as settling a previously numerical/conjectural point about absence of a logarithm at the first fold.

claims.statement: Continuing K past the first fold to s=-1 (the other preimage of z=0), the log cancellation reverses and adds: K(s) = (pi/4) log(1-s^2) + O(1) as s -> -1, whose residue coefficient works out to i*pi^2/2 after the q -> -q substitution that removes the first Catalan obstruction — i.e. the remaining monodromy at the second preimage is a pure Tate pi^2 defect that obstructs naive meromorphic continuation across a large disk.
claims.object: Catalan level-16 K-module, second-fold logarithmic obstruction
claims.notes: This is presented as the key negative/obstruction result of the sub-thread, ruling out a naive large-disk continuation argument for Catalan via this construction.

claims.statement: The known complementary zeta(2) Eisenstein extension cannot cancel the residual K-module logarithm: its local exponents at the returned cusp are 1, 1/2, 1/2 (half-integral Tate monodromy z^{1/2} log z), while the K-module has local exponents 1, 0, 0 (integer-exponent log z); since rational gauges/differential operators preserve local exponents mod Z, no scalar rational differential manipulation of that Tate module can cancel K's residual logarithm.
claims.object: Catalan level-16 K-module vs. zeta(2) Eisenstein extension, incompatibility theorem
claims.notes: Rules out an entire family of 'obvious repair' constructions for the scalar Catalan route.

claims.statement: Applying CDT's quantitative arithmetic-holonomy theorem to the K-leaf: with |phi'(0)| = pi and the tuple (1, s, K) giving denominator penalty tau = 10/9, the entry condition log(pi) = 1.144729... > 10/9 = 1.111... holds, but a Jensen-inequality argument shows a necessary condition for CDT's bound to contradict m=3 independent functions is L > (m-1)/m * tau = (2/3)(10/9) = 5/3, and log(pi) < 5/3 — so the basic quantitative CDT theorem cannot prove real Catalan irrationality from the level-16 K leaf, for any conformal map of size at most pi.
claims.object: Catalan level-16 K-module vs. CDT quantitative theorem, negative result
claims.notes: Explicit no-go theorem for the scalar level-16 approach specifically (not a claim that Catalan irrationality is impossible in general); thread concludes the vector-valued quintic system should be tried next instead.

claims.statement: The Catalan quintic vector-valued system has branch polynomial Delta_5(t) = 16t^4 - 32t^3 + 28t^2 - 12t + 1 with nearest root t_1 = 0.106924311121288..., giving reciprocal scale t_1^{-1} = 9.352... and -log(t_1) = 2.235... > 2; the orientation representation is genuinely D_4 with no invariant line, and the 5-isogeny algebra and orientation involution anticommute, explaining why this system resists scalarization.
claims.notes: Numerical/structural characterization only; presented as the next thing to attack, not yet constructed as a full arithmetic-holonomy object. Revised priority ranking given at end of chain: quintic rank-two/D_4 direct image > level-144 S_3 direct image > level-16 scalar K.
